legal_privacy_meta_description: How {siteName} handles account information, prompts, reference photos, video files, payments, cookies and privacy requests.
legal_privacy_intro: This policy explains how {siteName} handles information when you browse, use a free guest try, sign in, generate a video or buy credits. A guest try does not require an account, but it still involves technical information and a browser identifier.
legal_privacy_collect_account: Account and support information: your email, account and session identifiers, verification status, and messages you send us. Google sign-in may also provide your name, profile image and provider account information.
legal_privacy_collect_content: Creation information: your prompts, reference photos, generation settings, job status, generated files, credit usage and trial voucher eligibility, allocation and usage records. Signed-in users may receive a completion email containing a result link.
legal_privacy_collect_payment: Purchase information: order and payment references, product, amount, currency, payment status, refunds and credit ledger records. Card details are entered through Stripe Checkout; this application does not store full card numbers or security codes.
legal_privacy_collect_security: Technical information: IP address, browser information, timestamps, request or error details, a signed guest identifier, quota counters and referral or campaign information. This supports account security, daily limits, fraud prevention and understanding where visits come from.
legal_privacy_use_body: We use this information to operate accounts, render and deliver videos, maintain balances, process purchases and refunds, send sign-in codes and service notifications, answer support requests, enforce limits and investigate misuse. Referral information may be linked to an account when it is created. We do not sell your personal information or use your uploaded photos for targeted advertising.
legal_privacy_processors_body: Cloudflare provides hosting, database and file storage, plus security or email services where enabled. Stripe processes payments. Google provides Analytics 4 usage measurement as well as sign-in and One Tap where configured. Sign-in and completion emails use Resend or the configured Cloudflare email service. Our video API provider, Yir, and the underlying model provider process the prompt and any reference image needed to render your video. Anti-bot checks may use Cloudflare Turnstile or Google reCAPTCHA where configured.
legal_privacy_processors_more: These providers may process information in countries other than yours and apply their own policies. We do not promise that an upstream provider deletes every copy immediately or excludes all model-training uses. Do not submit confidential or sensitive material unless you are comfortable with the processing described here. Information may also be disclosed when necessary to comply with legal obligations, address abuse or protect rights.
legal_privacy_access_heading: Who can access a file link
legal_privacy_access_body: Uploaded reference images and completed videos use file links with random identifiers. Anyone who has a file link may be able to view or download it without signing in. Links may also be shared with providers to complete a render. Keep links confidential and avoid uploading identity documents, private financial information or other sensitive material. Public examples displayed on our homepage are separate from your own job history.
legal_privacy_retention_body: We retain account, job and file information to provide the service, support re-downloads, handle support and prevent abuse. Files may be removed during maintenance or storage management; the service is not a permanent backup. Payment, credit and dispute records may be retained where needed for accounting, fraud prevention or legal obligations. There is no universal automatic deletion period for all data categories.
legal_privacy_retention_more: File responses can be cached by browsers and delivery networks. Removing a stored file cannot recall copies that another person has already downloaded or retained. Download any work you want to keep.
legal_privacy_cookies_body: First-party cookies support sign-in, guest identification, language preferences where available, and referral attribution. The generator keeps your draft prompt, model, aspect ratio and reference paths in browser session storage so they can survive a reload or sign-in. Blocking cookies or storage may prevent sign-in, draft restoration or free-trial checks from working.
legal_privacy_cookies_more: Third-party sign-in, anti-bot and payment components may process browser or device signals and use their own storage under their policies. Basic referral attribution is not the same as an advertising profile. We do not describe all guest or technical data as anonymous.
legal_privacy_choices_body: You can use an available guest try without registering and choose whether to upload a reference photo. To request access, correction or deletion of account or creation data, contact us using the address below and identify the account and relevant job or file link. We may need to verify your control of the account before acting. We respond to privacy requests within 30 days and explain any records that must be retained for legal, accounting, security or dispute reasons.
legal_privacy_children_body: The service is not intended for children under 13, or under 16 where local law requires that minimum. Do not submit a child’s personal information. If you believe a child has provided information, contact us so we can review it. Material policy changes will be reflected on this page with an updated date.
legal_terms_meta_description: The rules for using {siteName}, including account security, acceptable content, AI output limitations, credit purchases and refunds.
legal_terms_intro: These terms cover your use of {siteName}, an AI video generation service. By using the service, you agree to these terms and the policies linked on this page. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
legal_terms_service_body: The service makes short AI videos from a prompt and, optionally, a reference photo using third-party models. Trial settings depend on the selected model and are shown before submission. The daily trial is limited to one request per device per day, shared before and after sign-in, and is subject to network limits, verification and daily availability. Eligible new verified accounts can receive one additional registration trial voucher, valid for 30 days from registration, subject to daily allocation. Credit costs depend on the selected model, resolution and duration and are shown before submission. Free access is not an unlimited entitlement or a promise of continuous availability.
legal_terms_account_body: Provide an email address you control and protect your sign-in codes and sessions. You are responsible for activity through your account and for having any consent needed to use the service. Do not bypass daily limits or security checks, create accounts to farm bonuses, share stolen access, overload the service or interfere with other users. We may restrict access to address misuse, security risks or legal obligations.
legal_terms_content_body: Only submit content you have the rights and permissions to use. Do not upload images of minors, use real people in misleading situations, create non-consensual sexual material, violate privacy or intellectual property rights, or submit unlawful content. Do not present AI-generated videos as authentic footage of real events. Review a result before publishing or relying on it.
legal_terms_rights_body: You retain your rights in your inputs and allow us and the necessary service providers to process them to provide the requested service. Rights in an output depend on applicable law and the underlying provider’s terms; we do not guarantee exclusive ownership, copyright protection, commercial suitability or clearance of third-party rights. Personal use is subject to these limits; broader use requires any additional rights or permissions. Anyone with an upload or result link may be able to access that file, as explained in the privacy policy.
legal_terms_credits_body: Credits are purchased in one-time packs and spent per generation. The applicable generation type, specifications and credit cost are shown before submission. Purchased credits do not expire unless a different expiry is disclosed at purchase. Previously issued promotional credits retain their existing expiry and eligibility terms. New registration rewards are separate trial vouchers, not paid credits or cash. A free daily allowance or registration voucher is used when a generation request is accepted, including if it later fails or is cancelled; it is not automatically restored. Credits and vouchers are not money and cannot be transferred or redeemed for cash except under the refund policy or where the law requires. Stripe processes payments.
legal_terms_delivery_body: A render may take time, be refused by a provider or fail. A credit-paid request is eligible for a credit return when rejection before submission is confirmed or the provider’s final charge is zero. If billing cannot yet be confirmed, the status remains pending and credits are not yet returned. If the provider has charged, credits are not automatically returned. Check the task status and contact support with its ID rather than resubmitting while it is pending. Accepted free requests use their daily allowance or registration voucher; failure or cancellation does not automatically restore that allowance. Credit returns are different from cash refunds for a purchase.
legal_terms_warranty_body: Outputs are provided as-is and may be inaccurate, imperfect, non-unique or unsuitable for a particular purpose. We do not guarantee a particular image, result, completion time or uninterrupted access. To the extent permitted by law, warranties are excluded and our total liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the preceding 12 months. Nothing here excludes rights or liabilities that cannot lawfully be excluded.
legal_terms_changes_body: We may change models, prices, limits or these terms. Material terms changes will be posted here with an updated date; review the displayed terms and cost before using a changed service. The privacy, refund and copyright policies explain related matters. Contact us below with questions or to report a problem.
legal_refunds_meta_description: How {siteName} handles failed render credits, cancellation, delivered results and requests to refund unused credit packs.
legal_refunds_intro: A return of generation credits restores your site balance. A purchase refund returns a payment through the payment provider. These are different processes; the conditions below explain each one.
legal_refunds_failed_body: A credit-paid request is eligible for a credit return when rejection before submission is confirmed or the provider’s final charge is zero. If billing has not settled or is unavailable, the status remains pending and credits are not yet returned. If the provider has charged, credits are not automatically returned. Check the task status and contact support with its ID rather than resubmitting while it is pending. Daily free trials and registration trial vouchers are used when a generation request is accepted; failure or cancellation does not automatically restore them, and they have no cash refund value. Contact support if a delivered result is clearly broken.
legal_refunds_cancel_body: A queued job may be cancelled when the generator offers that action. Accepted free requests still use their daily allowance or registration trial voucher after cancellation. Once the upstream provider has accepted and charged for a render, cancelling it or disliking a delivered result does not automatically return credits. Do not submit the same request again just because it is taking time; check the existing job first.
legal_refunds_unused_body: Ask within 14 days of purchase for a refund of unused credits. An entirely unused pack is refunded in full, minus payment-processor fees where applicable. For a partially used pack, the unused credits are refunded pro-rata at that pack’s per-credit price. Used credits and free promotional credits are not cash-refund balances. Mandatory consumer rights continue to apply.
legal_refunds_ask_body: Email the contact address below with your account email, order or payment reference, the relevant job or file link, and a short explanation. Never send a full card number, card security code, password or sign-in code. We answer within 5 business days. An acknowledgement does not itself approve a refund.
legal_refunds_process_heading: After a purchase refund is approved
legal_refunds_process_body: An approved purchase refund is processed through the original payment provider and the corresponding unused credits are removed or adjusted. The time until the money appears depends on the provider and your bank; it is separate from our response time. If a payment appears duplicated or unauthorized, contact us with the transaction references so we can investigate.
legal_dmca_meta_description: How to report copyright infringement to {siteName}, what a notice or counter-notice should contain, and how repeat infringement is handled.
legal_dmca_intro: {siteName} stores user-submitted reference images and generated videos. If you believe content accessible through this service infringes your copyright, send a specific report to the contact address below. Do not send a copyright complaint merely because you dislike a result.
legal_dmca_notice_body: Identify the protected work and the exact content or file link you are reporting. Include:
legal_dmca_notice_item_1: Your name, postal address, telephone number and email, plus a signature, typed or handwritten, from the rightsholder or authorized representative.
legal_dmca_notice_item_2: A clear description of the copyrighted work and the URL needed to locate the allegedly infringing material.
legal_dmca_notice_item_3: A statement that you reasonably believe the use has no permission from the rightsholder, its representative or the law.
legal_dmca_notice_item_4: A statement, under penalty of perjury, that the report is accurate and you own the relevant right or are authorized to act for its owner.
legal_dmca_notice_after: We answer within 5 business days and review sufficiently detailed reports. We may restrict access to the identified material and notify the affected user. A complaint and the contact information needed to handle it may be shared with that user.
legal_dmca_counter_body: If you believe material was removed through mistake or misidentification, a DMCA counter-notice should identify the material and its former location, include your signature, name, postal address and telephone number, and provide:
legal_dmca_counter_item_1: A statement under penalty of perjury that you have a good-faith belief that the content was removed or disabled because of a mistake or misidentification.
legal_dmca_counter_item_2: Consent to the U.S. federal district court for the district of your address, or, if you are outside the United States, a district where the service provider may be found; and agreement to accept service of court documents from the complainant or its representative.
legal_dmca_counter_after: A valid counter-notice may be forwarded to the complainant. Where the statutory DMCA procedure applies, material may be restored 10–14 business days after receipt unless we receive notice of a filed court action. A counter-notice does not override other grounds for restricting content.
legal_dmca_repeat_body: Accounts subject to repeated valid infringement notices may be terminated. For privacy, impersonation or other safety concerns, describe the issue and provide the relevant link; do not label a non-copyright issue as a DMCA claim. Misrepresentations in legal notices can have legal consequences.
legal_privacy_analytics_body: We use Google Analytics 4 to understand visits and improve the site. It can receive page views, page addresses and referring pages, browser and device information, and interaction measurements enabled in the Analytics configuration. It may use first-party cookies and browser identifiers to distinguish visits and sessions. This information is processed by Google under its policies and the configured Analytics settings; we do not describe it as fully anonymous or promise a fixed retention period here.
legal_privacy_analytics_more: Our analytics code does not attach prompt text, uploaded photos or generated video files to Google Analytics events. Avoid placing personal information in page addresses. Browser cookie settings and Google’s Analytics opt-out browser add-on, where supported, provide additional controls over Analytics measurement; these controls do not delete the separate account or creation records described above.
